secondary.title: Anthropic proposes law regulating AI to US lawmakers
secondary.summary: Anthropic, the creator of the AI assistant Claude, confirmed on Friday it is circulating a draft bill among US lawmakers aimed at regulating artificial intelligence to address the lack of federal legislation on the risks posed by the new technology.

stories.title: Chip maker Nvidia shares climb as AI demand stays strong
stories.summary: Shares rose after the company said demand for AI chips remains high. Investors are watching supply limits closely.

stories.summary: The central bank kept its policy interest rate unchanged. Officials said inflation is cooling but risks remain.

stories.summary: A young company building cold-chain logistics for farmers has closed a seed funding round. It plans to expand to three new regions.
